paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: Jesus is alive, and that changes EVERYTHING. The angel says, "He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!" (Matthew 28:6). He said it would happen, and it happened. So when Jesus says something else is coming, you can trust Him.

Look at the two groups who got the news. The chief priests paid a large sum of money to bury the truth (Matthew 28:12-13), and the women ran with it in fear and great joy (Matthew 28:8). The empty tomb is true whether people hide it or share it. And even on the mountain, "some doubted" (Matthew 28:17), and Jesus still came right to them and spoke. I bet that's good news for any baker who has ever wondered if they believe enough.

Then comes the part that's for you. Jesus says, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me" (Matthew 28:18). Because of that, He sends them to "make disciples of all nations" (Matthew 28:19). Then He adds, "And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age" (Matthew 28:20). You don't carry the job alone, friend, and that's why my ovens stay ready.
